<strong>An app</strong> wants to use thi: An app wants to use this library: search and read your notebooks and books, edit text boxes, and manage tasks.
<strong>Browsing is read-only.</strong>: Browsing is read-only. Opening notebooks or pages here never changes your tablets. Only a few actions write back: deleting numbered notebooks, uploading a book, refreshing reading data and audio recovery. Each of those says so before you confirm.
<strong>Confirm.</strong> Only then are: Confirm. Only then are pages sent for recognition.
<strong>Going back to Onyx</strong>: use: Going back to Onyx: use Restore in PowerSync on the tablet. Revoking a device here only removes its access to this server; it does not switch the tablet back.
<strong>Page previews</strong> are drawn: Page previews are drawn on the server from the ink files received so far. Pen textures are approximate. A missing preview does not mean the page is blank; some files may still be on their way.

<strong>Provider</strong>: whether the s: Provider: whether the saved embedding service answers. Semantic search: whether you turned it on. Index: whether the vectors are built. A ready provider does not mean the feature is on.
<strong>Published</strong> means the del: Published means the deletion reached the sync server; each tablet applies it on its next sync. Pending items retry automatically, and this page refreshes while work remains. Blocked notebooks changed after your review; superseded ones were edited on a device after publication. Review current matches before trying again.
<strong>Reading</strong> shows books, hi: Reading shows books, highlights and bookmarks from NeoReader. Page numbers are shown exactly as the tablet recorded them. You can upload EPUB, PDF, MOBI or AZW3 books (up to 128 MiB); each tablet downloads a book when you open it in its library.

<strong>Text available</strong> is what: Text available is what could be indexed. Embedded is what the active index holds. Pending includes failures waiting for retry. BOOX pages without recognized text are not indexed — semantic search never starts handwriting recognition.
<strong>When two tablets disagree</stron: When two tablets disagree, Alexandria follows the same winner the tablets' own sync chooses. Every version the server sees is kept, so earlier versions can be recovered, but changes a tablet never sent can't be recovered.
<strong>Words and meaning</strong> (show: Words and meaning (shown when search by meaning is on) also finds related ideas. Exact words only matches what you typed. Use the source menu to narrow results to one source.
